notes: Diagnostic codes for pack configuration, templates, settings, cold properties and pack icons. severity: E error, W warning, I information (configurable for property.cold). python: true when the Python linter must report the code as well (no reflection data there).

codes.summary: type: config used in a file that is not named *.config.yml/.yaml
*.config.yml file declares a different explicit type
field id used twice in the pack (case-insensitive)
one id is the dotted prefix of another (a.b vs a.b.c)
id equals true, false, in or contains
default violates valueType, width, range, step, maxLength, options or list shape
min > max, bounds outside the valueType width, slider combined with multiple, invalid count bounds
definition above a runtime limit: list maxCount/maxSelected or default above 64 elements, maxLength above 1024, id longer than 200 characters, pack ref longer than 50 characters (packs with configs)
duplicate option value or option value not matching valueType
neither the field nor the document defines a category
category is not a UFGCategory descendant / unknown bare id (warning when only absent from the snapshot)
descriptionClass / properties are reserved for a later version and ignored
referenced config id does not exist in the pack
cfg:<pack>:<id> names a pack that is not part of the project
referenced pack has enabled: false
reference differs from the definition only in letter case
config value type is incompatible (E) or lossy (W) for the target slot; Python only checks schema-level types
typed reference or template in a position the runtime never resolves (id, type, include, ref, map keys, conditions subtrees)
hot field used in a cold context; changes need a restart
hot field used in a load-time condition (pack.yml or a cold document)
hot field feeds a cold or newActors property
config expression does not parse (sub-code = expression error code)
config expression type issue (sub-code = type issue code)
unquoted expression breaks YAML or becomes a tag (leading ! [ ' " & * % @ `)
config condition value is neither a string nor a list of strings
config: condition used inside a config definition document
plain scalar starts with { and is parsed as a flow mapping; quote it
{prefix: without a matching }
empty id, bad id syntax, missing member or malformed typed reference
near-miss of a registered prefix (edit distance <= 1); other unknown {..} stays literal and silent
templates nested deeper than 4 levels
member is neither a property nor a function of the target
function exists but violates the call allowlist
argument count differs from the input parameter count
argument literal cannot convert to the parameter type
target class/object is not of the provider's base class
class in a template or category is absent from the reflection snapshot (existing code, reused)
setting id not found in indexes/settings.json (only reported when the index exists)
setting value type does not fit the target slot
op path targets a cold or newActors property; /kdf reload and hot configs do not update it live (Python: only with an explicit target class)
relative icon file does not exist
relative icon path leaves the pack folder
icon is not png, jpg, jpeg, tga or bmp
icon path resolves through a symlink outside the pack
/... texture object path has invalid syntax
